data.text: Clarification: Updated wording for Additional Secondary Objective from 'relationships between retatrutide and safety, tolerability, and efficacy measures' to 'relationships between retatrutide exposure and safety, tolerability, and efficacy measures'.
Clarification: Additional note added to clarify the intended purpose of each estimand. Added a clarification to the definition of 'population' for treatment regimen and efficacy estimand attributes.

Added language for monitoring and routinely assessing the need to adjust or discontinue antihypertensive medications, diuretics, laxatives, and anti-emetics for concomitant medications. For consistency with recommendations in Sections 6.9.1 and 10.10.

Added language for monitoring for and encouraging adequate nutritional intake and hydration throughout the study as part of the participant education. For consistency with recommendations in Sections 5.3.3 and 5.3.4.

Added additional evaluations for 'Lifestyle considerations, diabetes education (including BG meter and SMBG training), and meals and nutrition' to all visits, expanding beyond the existing evaluation at Visit 2. To incorporate additional counseling and monitoring for patient safety.
Added an additional evaluation of antihypertensive and lipid-lowering medications at ED visit. To assess the 'change in antihypertensive and lipid-lowering medications' endpoint at ED visit.
Clarification: Added a note in Inclusion Criterion 8 to address the usage of gender-neutral terms (AMAB and AFAB) in the document. For clarification and consistency with TRANSCEND T2D protocols.
Clarification: Removed the word 'clinically significant' from Exclusion Criterion 22. Clarification to avoid ambiguity.
Clarification: Defined study intervention in Exclusion Criterion 36 as retatrutide, placebo, or an active comparator.
Updated calcitonin units from 'ng/L' to 'pg/mL (Conventional) and pmol/L (SI)' in Exclusion Criterion 24 and in Section 8.3.3.8. To align with central lab reporting.

data.text: The SoA described below should be followed for all participants enrolled in Study J1I-MC-GZBY (GZBY). However, for those participants whose participation in this study is affected by exceptional circumstances, such as pandemics or natural disasters, please refer to Section 10.14 for additional guidance.
Visit procedures may be conducted over more than 1 day if all activities are completed within the allowed visit tolerance period of each visit.

On all fasting visits, study participants are required to report to the site in a fasting condition, after at least 8 hours without eating, drinking (except water), or performing any significant physical activity. Additionally, the participant should not take their study intervention before the fasting visit. If a participant is adversely affected by the fasting condition, they are allowed to eat; however, specific study procedures need to be completed while fasting.
If a participant attends a fasting visit in the non-fasting state, reschedule the visit at a time within the allowable visit interval.

Visit 2 may occur as soon as the criteria for Visit 1 are confirmed. At Visit 2, screening laboratory results will be reviewed to confirm eligibility. Visit 3 to occur no sooner than 18 days after Visit 1.
The only procedure performed for PK only visits is PK sample collection.
data.sourceSection: 1.3 Schedule of Activities (SoA) - PK only visits

data.text: For early discontinuation that occurs before the last visit in treatment period, see the activities listed for ED in the SoA.

data.text: A posttreatment safety follow-up visit will occur approximately 4 weeks following the last treatment period visit. Participants who have discontinued study intervention early and are only willing to come back for Visit 11 (Week 40) are not required to complete a safety follow-up visit if they have been off of study intervention for at least 28 days (see Section 7.1.1).

data.description: Original Protocol for Study J1I-MC-GZBY - A Phase 3, Randomized, Multicenter, Double-Blind Study to Investigate the Efficacy and Safety of Retatrutide Once Weekly Compared with Placebo in Adult Participants with Type 2 Diabetes and Inadequate Glycemic Control with Diet and Exercise Alone (TRANSCEND-T2D-1)

Protocol Amendment (a) for Study J1I-MC-GZBY. Key changes include: addition of new AESI of 'malnutrition and inadequate fluid intake'; updated title and text for AESI of 'ketoacidosis due to inadequate nutritional intake and other types of metabolic acidosis and ketosis'; more detailed guidance on recommending, monitoring, and managing nutritional intake and hydration; updated criteria for dose modification; and inclusion of adjudication of urgent visit for heart failure.
